relationships.subject: GATA6+ peritoneal macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: Higher TRPV1+ neurons were detected in Gata6f/f mice at day 21 compared with those in Mac Gata6 KO mice

relationships.subject: GATA6+ peritoneal macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: When cytokine levels were compared between Gata6f/f and Mac Gata6 KO mice at each time point, TNFα at day 21 in Gata6f/f mice was higher than in Mac Gata6 KO mice

relationships.subject: GATA6+ peritoneal macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: These results support that peritoneal GATA6+ macrophages are involved in the recruitment and reprogramming of monocyte-derived macrophages.

key_findings: After lesion induction, TRPV1 and CGRP increased in DRG; levels stayed higher longer in Gata6f/f than myeloid Gata6 KO mice
GATA6 deficiency did not affect lesion number or macrophage infiltration but altered macrophage repopulation and later TNFα and hyperalgesia
